scientific_integrity: A theorem about the standard long-time Cesaro mixing matrix, not randomized-time uniform mixing; explicit algebraic proof and independently replayable symbolic calculations. No claim of independent certification or experimental completeness.
scientific_limitations: Only primitive strongly regular graphs (diameter two); does not settle larger-diameter primitive distance-regular graphs. The graph examples are nonexhaustive. An equivalent result in an unlocated association-scheme source is a residual novelty risk.
title: Full rank of long-time quantum mixing on primitive strongly regular graphs
